{{Quote|It's a suicide mission!|This soldier to Lieutenant Ulabore|<ref name="Darth Bane: Path of Destruction">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Gloom Walkers]] during the [[Battle of Phaseera]]. They were led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ulabore]] in an attempt to destroy the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost on [[Phaseera]], which would allow the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] army to destroy the Republic's base camp. This soldier shouted out that the mission would result in their deaths when Ulabore told his men their orders. Despite knowing that it would get cause more Gloom Walkers to die, Ulabore refused to listen to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel's]] protests. This angered Dessel, who punched his lieutenant in the jaw, which left Ulabore unconscious and allowed Dessel to command the soldiers.
